name: Six More Enchantments
summary: New enchantments for longer reach, step assist, higher jumps, extra hearts, faster walking and steady footing, straight from the enchanting table.
logoPrompt: A single open enchanted book glowing with purple light, with a few small floating rune particles above its pages, centred, in blocky voxel style

cover.tagline: Six fair enchantments from the table.

description: **Six More Enchantments adds six new enchantments to the enchanting table, each a small, fair boost.**
- Reach I–II (pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe): half a block more reach per level.
- Stepping (boots): walk up full blocks without jumping.
- Leaping I–II (boots): jump higher and fall one more block per level without damage. Level II clears fences.
- Vitality I–II (chestplate): one extra heart per level, instead of a protection enchantment.
- Swiftness or Steadfast I–II (leggings): walk 5% faster or take 10% less knockback per level.
Put the zip into the `datapacks` folder of your world (or pick it when you create a new world). Then enchant tools, armour or books at an enchanting table as usual.
- Made for Minecraft: Java Edition 1.21, 1.21.1 and 26.3. Works in singleplayer and on servers; players need nothing installed.
- The new enchantments only come from the enchanting table, not from loot, villagers or mobs. Stepping and Leaping exclude each other, as do Swiftness and Steadfast.
- Keep the pack in a world once items carry these enchantments.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
